title: Voertuig overschrijven of vrijwaring regelen
notes: Use RDW OpenAPI to discover both transfer and vrijwaren operations. For the demo, the generated ag-ui form must be consistent: one required dropdown where the user chooses Vrijgeven or Overschrijven. Use field name vehicle_action with option value vrijwaren for Vrijgeven and option value overschrijven for Overschrijven. When the user chooses Overschrijven, show exactly three additional required fields: new_owner_bsn as text labelled BSN nieuwe eigenaar, new_owner_name as text labelled Naam nieuwe eigenaar, and reason as select labelled Reden. The reason dropdown must offer Erven, Verkopen and Schenken with values erven, verkopen and schenken, and must default to erven. Infer legal basis such as ERFRECHT when the context supports it; do not ask for data that can be inferred outside this required user choice.
